b = a<128

ys,xs = np.where(mask)
pts = sorted(zip(xs,ys))
for y in range(130,170):
    row = xs[ys==y]
    if len(row): print(y, row.min(), row.max())
# also component 33 (T junction)

ys3,xs3 = np.where(mask33)
print('comp33 x', xs3.min(), xs3.max(), 'y', ys3.min(), ys3.max())
for y in range(135,145):
    row = xs3[ys3==y]
